text:
GT World Series 2026 | Round 3 - Singapore | Nations Cup [ENGLISH]
The 2026 World Series has now passed its halfway mark, with Round 3 taking place in Singapore.

In the previous Round in Tokyo, reigning champion José Serrano dominated the race right up until the final lap, only to drop to 5th place due to a costly penalty. This dramatic turn of events has significantly impacted the Points Ranking, in a race where the all the Spaniards were expected to hold the advantage.

Will current leader Kylian Drumont, fresh off his victory in the chaotic Round 2, build momentum to pull away from the pack? Will the Spanish drivers stage a comeback? Or will Valerio Gallo, who has been biding his time and closing in on the leaders, finally launch a serious charge?

With the World Finals fast approaching, the battle for the Nations Cup is becoming increasingly unpredictable. Witness how the competition unfolds!

A separate Live Timing stream where viewers can check position changes, sector times, and other race statistics in real-time is also available. We hope you'll enjoy this new feature:
https://youtube.com/live/EJD-q6H0JME
